cpmplus.tooltip.wizard: Creates animations that react to movement:\falling, running, turning, jumping, landing and more.
cpmplus.tooltip.peso: How long the part takes to react.\0 = instantly, 10 = very slowly.
cpmplus.tooltip.mola: How much it overshoots and swings back.\0 = none, 10 = a lot.
cpmplus.tooltip.forca: How sensitive it is to movement.\5 = normal, 10 = reaches the end with half the movement.
cpmplus.tooltip.limite: How far the animation goes.\10 = the whole animation, 5 = halfway.
cpmplus.tooltip.limiar: On/off layers only: how strong the movement\must be to switch the animation on. 5 = halfway.
cpmplus.tooltip.toggle: Creates a layer that switches on and off,\instead of a slider that follows the strength.
cpmplus.wizard.name: Name: %s
cpmplus.tooltip.create: Creates a new animation with this name.\Then add the frames: the first one is the rest pose.
cpmplus.tooltip.apply: Renames the selected animation,\keeping anything after the #.
cpmplus.trigger.esquerda.desc: Grows when strafing to the left
cpmplus.trigger.direita.desc: Grows when strafing to the right
cpmplus.trigger.pouso.desc: A jolt when hitting the ground
cpmplus.trigger.pulo.desc: A jolt at the moment of the jump
